decision: No must-fix found in bounded old/new configuration, annotation/record, selected actual AGP entry and execution-boundary comparison. Supports ongoing authorized candidate validation; does not close application release shrinking or native acceptance.

findings.finding: New normal DEX default excludes wildcard matches for runtime-invisible annotation attributes; explicit names are retained. Classfile default allows wildcard matches; explicit system property wins. Matches prior four-run controlled smoke, without proving application-generated configuration.

Parser now supports negated member-name patterns, rejects backreferences to negated matches and records rule ends without trailing whitespace; unsupported options routed through consumer. No new config downloader. Only parser/changed plumbing observed, not exhaustive matcher correctness proof.

New annotation index bounds candidate sets for simple single-annotation/member all-class rules. KEEP and NoAccessModification rules decline indexing; unknown/oversized sets fall back to full candidates. Classpath/library annotation types and missing annotation definitions considered. Whole-program rule evaluation remains a signed-application gate.

AGP now passes local keep files with Maven/AGP/path origin metadata and still selects minApi, normal output consumer and R8.run. D8 adds opt-in no-op global-synthetic consumer. New library-analyzer entry points are not invoked by inspected AGP path.

New configuration-analysis/assistant diagnostics use explicit local output consumer/property/path. Early exit requires singleton empty DEX consumer; ordinary AGP invocation supplies concrete program consumer and does not request these diagnostics.

AtomicReferenceFieldUpdater optimization changes from disabled to enabled by default in whole-program DEX/minApi>=19. Inspected eligibility rejects unsuitable reflected fields/operations, catch-handler operations decline optimization, null/type checks retained. Sv2 compareAndSet backport registration no longer suppressed by optimization flag. This focused code read does not establish all atomic optimization correctness or Android runtime equivalence.

Class-to-DEX partition refinement changes0->5 passes and legroom5->0; debug mode skips refinement by default. Actual release timing/resource use and native startup remain required; passing debug/small fixture is insufficient.

CF archive output sorted by obfuscated descriptor then written immediately and result buffers cleared; output-consumer helpers factored; embedded rule readSources preserves version-filtered relevant-rule precedence. Local input/output paths retained.

All24 old/new resource-shrinker files paired after package relocation. Remaining normalized diffs are import reorderings/unused import removal only; this is source comparison, not application resource-shrinking acceptance.
